import subprocess

units = [
    ("prediction-research-hourly-director.timer", True),
    ("prediction-codex-supervisor.timer", True),
    ("prediction-command-bus.timer", True),
    ("prediction-chat-wake.service", True),
    ("prediction-research-hourly-director.service", False),
    ("prediction-codex-supervisor.service", False),
]

rows = []
for unit, must_be_active in units:
    p = subprocess.run(["systemctl","--user","is-active",unit], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    active = (p.stdout or "").strip()
    q = subprocess.run(["systemctl","--user","is-enabled",unit], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    enabled = (q.stdout or "").strip()
    show = subprocess.run(["systemctl","--user","show",unit], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    props = {}
    for line in (show.stdout or "").splitlines():
        if "=" in line:
            k,v=line.split("=",1)
            if k in {"ActiveState","SubState","Result","ExecMainStatus","UnitFileState","NextElapseUSecRealtime","LastTriggerUSec","InactiveExitTimestamp","ActiveEnterTimestamp"}:
                props[k]=v
    rows.append((unit,must_be_active,active,enabled,props))

for unit,must_be_active,active,enabled,props in rows:
    print("UNIT",unit,"ACTIVE",active,"ENABLED",enabled,"PROPS",props, flush=True)

for unit in ["prediction-research-hourly-director.service","prediction-codex-supervisor.service","prediction-command-bus.service","prediction-chat-wake.service"]:
    p=subprocess.run(["journalctl","--user","-u",unit,"-n","20","--no-pager"],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    tail="\n".join((p.stdout or "").splitlines()[-8:])
    print("JOURNAL",unit,tail.replace("\n"," || "),flush=True)

bad=[unit for unit,must,active,_,_ in rows if must and active!="active"]
summary=";".join(f"{u}={a}" for u,_,a,_,_ in rows)
print("AUTONOMY_RUNTIME_SUMMARY="+summary,flush=True)
if bad:
    print("AUTONOMY_REQUIRED_INACTIVE="+",".join(bad),flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(41)
print("AUTONOMY_REQUIRED_ACTIVE=PASS",flush=True)
